skill.name: web-artifacts-builder
skill.description: Build complex Claude web artifacts with a generated React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui project workflow.
skill.summary: Creates React-based web artifact projects and bundles them into single HTML files for Claude conversations.
skill.author: anthropics

security_audit.summary: The skill performs expected local project generation work, including Bash execution, package installation, local file writes, and archive extraction. No prompt injection attempt was found, and several markdown and documentation URL matches are false positives. The main residual risk is supply chain exposure from npm package installation and the bundled component archive.

remediation.issue: Package installation runs during setup and bundling.
remediation.suggestion: Pin all direct package versions where possible and document that npm lifecycle scripts may run during installation.

remediation.issue: The initializer installs pnpm globally when it is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before global installation or use corepack so the change is explicit.

remediation.issue: A binary tarball contains source files that static scanners cannot fully inspect.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the shadcn component files as normal source files or include a checksum and manifest for the archive.

content.value_statement: Complex web artifacts need project structure, reusable components, and reliable bundling. This skill creates a React workflow and packages it into one shareable HTML artifact.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 and TypeScript project with Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui theming defaults.
Adds path aliases for imports under the src directory.
Installs Radix UI and related shadcn component dependencies.
Extracts prepared shadcn component files into the project.
Bundles the finished app into one HTML file with inlined assets.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or later and a working package manager environment.
Downloads npm packages during setup, so offline use is limited.
Best suited for complex React artifacts, not small static HTML snippets.
Generated projects still require user review, design work, and testing.

prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate artifact design with reusable controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a multi-panel artifact using shadcn/ui components. Include navigation, forms, tables, and responsive layout choices.

prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a completed project for sharing.

prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced project with state, routing, and validation.

output_examples.input: A request to package an existing Vite artifact for Claude.
output_examples.output: A generated bundle.html file with JavaScript, CSS, and assets inlined into one document.

best_practices: Use this skill when the artifact needs state, reusable components, or several screens.
Review generated dependencies and scripts before running them in sensitive environments.
Test the bundled HTML when the artifact includes complex interactions or browser APIs.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for a small static page that fits in one file.
Do not run setup scripts in repositories that contain unrelated production files.
Do not assume the bundled artifact is polished without reviewing layout and interactions.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui project for building Claude web artifacts.

faq.question: Does it produce a single shareable file?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundling script creates bundle.html with assets inlined for sharing as an artifact.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it for complex artifacts that need components, state management, routing, or a structured frontend workflow.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: You need Node.js 18 or later. The scripts use pnpm and may install it if missing.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. Project setup and bundling install packages from npm registries in normal use.

faq.question: Can Codex or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
